facts.text: The hotel is at 5 Rue de la Paix in Paris's 2nd arrondissement.
facts.excerpt: 5 Rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris, France

facts.text: Place Vendome and the Opera Garnier are steps from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Place Vendôme and Opéra Garnier are just steps away.

facts.text: SEOK is three-Michelin-starred chef Mingoo Kang's first restaurant in Paris.
facts.excerpt: SEOK is three-Michelin-starred chef Mingoo Kang’s first restaurant in Paris.

facts.text: SEOK serves Korean cuisine inspired by the traditions and hospitality of Seoul.
facts.excerpt: SEOK offers authentic and generous Korean cuisine inspired by the traditions and hospitality of Seoul.

facts.text: Restaurant PUR' was redesigned by artist-architect Hugo Toro in fall 2024.
facts.excerpt: After all those years, the restaurant finally got the design refresh it deserved in fall 2024.

facts.text: PUR' pairs the designs of artist-architect Hugo Toro with the cooking of chef Jean-Francois Rouquette.
facts.excerpt: blending the visionary designs of artist-architect Hugo Toro with the culinary brilliance of Michelin-starred Chef Jean-François Rouquette

facts.text: PUR' offers contemporary French cuisine with an exclusive Chef's Table experience.
facts.excerpt: invites guests to discover contemporary French cuisine, enhanced by the exclusive Chef's Table experience

facts.text: PUR' holds one Michelin star and four Gault&Millau toques.
facts.excerpt: One Michelin Star and Four Gault&Millau Toques

facts.text: The spa partners exclusively with the La Mer cosmetics brand.
facts.excerpt: The hotel exclusively partners with the prestigious La Mer cosmetics brand.

facts.text: The spa has a jetted tub, a sauna, a steam room and treatment rooms including one for couples.
facts.excerpt: Nestled beside the inviting jetted tub, the cozy relaxation lounge is surrounded by a sauna, a steam room and 4 exquisite treatment rooms (including one duo).

facts.text: Hairstylist John Nollet runs a hair salon in Suite 101 of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: John Nollet offers an exceptional range of exclusive cutting and care protocols in his Suite 101.

facts.text: All rooms were updated in 2017 by American designer Ed Tuttle in a warm neutral and gold palette.
facts.excerpt: All rooms, including mine on the sixth floor (639), were updated in 2017 by American designer Ed Tuttle in a warm neutral and gold palette.

facts.text: Sixth-floor rooms have balconies with views of Parisian rooftops and Place Vendome.
facts.excerpt: The sixth and top floor benefits from unobstructed views of Parisian rooftops and even the Place Vendôme from the room's balconies.

facts.text: Deluxe rooms have limestone bathrooms with a deep soaking tub and separate rainfall shower.
facts.excerpt: The elegant limestone bathroom features a deep soaking tub and separate rainfall shower.

facts.text: Perfumer Christophe Laudamiel created the hotel's signature scent.
facts.excerpt: Here, he created both the signature olfactive scent for the entirety of the hotel spaces

facts.text: L'Appartement is a private apartment with a view over the roofs of Paris.
facts.excerpt: It’s artfully designed, offers five-star service and features a view over the roofs of Paris.

facts.text: Cafe Jeanne serves an all-day menu at the bar, by the fireplace or on the terrace.
facts.excerpt: Whether installed at the bar counter, in the restaurant seats, near the fireplace or on the terrace, a unique menu made up of gastronomic essentials is offered all day long until late night.

facts.text: La Terrasse du Park is a sunlit terrace in the heart of the hotel, sheltered by historic facades.
facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of the hotel, sheltered by historic facades, this charming, sunlit terrace is the perfect spot to enjoy springtime lunches and lively dinners.

facts.text: Cafe Jeanne offers La Biscuiterie, a seasonal experience by chef Narae Kim.
facts.excerpt: Discover "La Biscuiterie" experience, a unique and seasonal culinary journey crafted by Chef Narae Kim.

facts.text: Le Chalet du Park will reopen on November 16, 2026.
facts.excerpt: The Chalet du Park will reopen on November 16, 2026

facts.text: Pets are welcome for a daily fee, but not in Restaurant PUR' or the spa.
facts.excerpt: Pets are not allowed at Restaurant PUR' - Jean-François Rouquette and our Spa.

facts.text: Opera metro station, served by lines 3, 7 and 8, is nearby.
facts.excerpt: Metro lines 3, 7 and 8 at Opéra Metro Station provide access to the Louvre, Champ de Mars, Notre-Dame Cathedral and more.

facts.text: The hotel has nearly 700 square meters of meeting and event space.
facts.excerpt: With nearly 700 square meters (7,500 square feet) of customizable space

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler readers named the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2023, 2025 and 2026.
Conde Nast Traveler calls it possibly the most understated of Paris's luxury hotels.
facts.excerpt: Of all of Paris's luxury hotels, this one may be the most understated.
